timeline.summary: Host Alien claimed the MB-001 migration stage. Digital-City claim commit cc45ea203801d2c34c40924f55b4fa92b9b9768e pushed to City main with no write conflict. Implementation branch mission/MB-001-core-os created from utopia main c7ef3cd1c6be0155332d03afc3607dfdbf49c205.

Reconnaissance: City target city/00-foundation/01-city-core does not yet exist in Utopia. city/CITY_IMPLEMENTATION_MANIFEST.json declares only 02-engineering, 06-research, 09-planning-knowledge, 11-entertainment and city/tests/manifest.test.mjs pins that census exactly, so registering a new 00-foundation district must extend that census rather than weaken it. Donor inventory of the four MB-001 capability clusters is in progress.

Landed city/00-foundation/01-city-core/task-lifecycle (cluster B, donor candidate-gate.ts 35) and audit-ledger (cluster D, donor decision-ledger.ts + candidate-gate.ts 36): 34 tests green. Extended city/CITY_IMPLEMENTATION_MANIFEST.json with the 00-foundation district and four City Core modules, and extended city/tests/manifest.test.mjs with the module census plus a new machine-checked mission-incubation provenance contract (mb-<MISSION_ID>-<module>-lab must carry a module.mission block that agrees with the module DONOR.json).

Extending the City manifest broke four pre-existing tests that hard-coded container indices or global counts: tests/capability-registry.test.mjs indexed districts[0]/districts[2] by position, tests/capability-adapters.test.mjs asserted catalog.length===6, and city/tests/manifest.test.mjs used districts[1] to build its duplicate-incubation-room case. A fifth, self-inflicted failure was caught by a new test before commit: the audit-ledger DONOR factory spread a string into a character array and so turned an invalid ledger entry into a valid one.

Repairs: index-based test references were replaced with lookups by id, preserving each test's intent while removing its dependence on district ordering; the two global-count assertions were scoped to the module refs under test; the missing readFile import was added; the ledger factory now passes a non-array through untouched so validation remains the single gate. The capability surface was restored to exactly its pre-MB-001 shape by declaring 00-foundation as an infrastructure district and teaching the capability registry to skip infrastructure modules, so kernel modules are never advertised to Web or Android as unavailable capabilities. No assertion was deleted, skipped or weakened.

Full CI-equivalent suite green after the repairs: pnpm test 60/60, apps/rooms tests 67/67, city/test-all.mjs 229/229, verify-promotion-history.mjs 10 records verified, check:docs PAIR_STATUS SYNCHRONIZED in docs, evidence and data-records. New City Core module tests: root-authority 18, task-lifecycle 11, fleet-routing 28, audit-ledger 42.

Real consumption verified end to end: a real dev-gateway instance on loopback accepted a task over HTTP, and its node-claim placement decision is now made by the migrated City Core fleet-routing module. tests/gateway.test.mjs proves the running gateway agrees with the Core and refuses exactly what the Core refuses: an online fully capable node is placed, a node missing a required capability is refused, and a node that has gone offline while still listing the capabilities is refused and its work stays QUEUED. Protocol, state names, event names and response shapes are unchanged.

Hosted required CI green for the implementation SHA 8a7fe21e1ad860bbc06866344f97abda6fb9e165: V0.2 checks run 36566575068 completed success, both jobs success (gateway-web, android). The claim-stage push 82ec136c3376d084693ad16250f510893b789a78 also ran green under run 36564561252. Local CI-equivalent results on the same tree: pnpm test 60/60, apps/rooms 67/67, city/test-all.mjs 229/229, verify-promotion-history 10 records, check:docs SYNCHRONIZED, Android :app:testDebugUnitTest :app:assembleDebug BUILD SUCCESSFUL.

MB-001 migration stage complete on host Alien. Four City Core modules landed under city/00-foundation/01-city-core (root-authority, task-lifecycle, fleet-routing, audit-ledger), 99 module tests, all parity-tested against donor 8df428e. Real consumption: the dev-gateway node-claim placement decision is owned by the migrated fleet-routing module with byte-identical behaviour. Recorded boundaries, not hidden: clusters A, B and D have no product consumer yet; root-authority ships mechanism without an active protected manifest; cluster B is the lifecycle half only. Branch not merged to main and mission:finalize not run, per the mission-book. City report: Digital-City/mission-book/reports/MB-001/MIGRATION_REPORT.md.

Verification host Mech begins the criteria assessment after the rule 9 reconciliation. Independent Part A review and Part B reconciliation are committed to City main (03c9f75, 17b6497). Planned work: strengthen the restart/recovery evidence the Mission's Mission-specific evidence list requires, fix the circular expectation in tests/gateway.test.mjs, then run the criteria assessment and repair pass.

Verification finding (independent review, before the Migration Report): the new City Core consumption test derived its expectation by calling the same acceptsWork under test with a locally re-typed capability list, so it could not catch a wrong REQUIRED_TASK_CAPABILITIES. Second finding: donor parity is stated as prose vectors in DONOR.json with no differential harness present on the branch, so equivalence to Codex-Boss 8df428e could not be confirmed by construction. Third: the Mission Verification gate 'restart/recovery durable identity is not falsified as success' had no receipt from the migration host for this branch.

Two repairs on the same Mission branch, both inside the boundary and neither adding capability. (1) services/dev-gateway/server.mjs now exports REQUIRED_TASK_CAPABILITIES, and tests/gateway.test.mjs states fixed expectations over the gateway's own HTTP responses instead of deriving them from the acceptsWork under test; a mutation check proved the repaired test now FAILS when the policy is weakened to a single capability, which the old form could not detect. (2) tests/gateway.test.mjs gains an explicit restart/recovery receipt: a task genuinely RUNNING at 20 percent when the process dies is FAILED with its original id and progress after the restart, never COMPLETED, the restarted gateway assumes no node is online, a stale node cannot claim fresh work, and the audit journal appends after the original history. No test was deleted, skipped or weakened; assertions were added and one circular expectation was replaced by a discriminating one.

Verification gates green on the repaired revision 932196e4bcd0: pnpm test 61/61 (60 before the new restart test), city/test-all.mjs 229/229, apps/rooms 67/67, verify-promotion-history 10 records, check:docs PAIR_STATUS SYNCHRONIZED. Android lane rebuilt FROM SCRATCH on this host with JDK 17 (the default JDK 26 and the Android Studio JBR 25.0.3 both break Gradle 8.14.3's Kotlin script compiler with IllegalArgumentException before configuration): :app:testDebugUnitTest :app:assembleDebug BUILD SUCCESSFUL, 41/41 tasks executed, 21/21 unit tests, app-debug.apk 10320163 bytes. Donor parity rebuilt from the frozen donor tree cloned at 8df428e: donor-parity-check 11/11 and donor-grammar-differential 50000/50000 patterns with 350000/350000 path verdicts and 8/8 CODEOWNERS parse cases, plus all three grammar functions reducing to the same canonical token stream.

Hosted required CI green for the verification repair SHA 932196e4bcd0: V0.2 checks run 36583350117 completed success, both jobs success (gateway-web 2m48s, android 1m16s). This is the implementation-code green required before the rule 16 finalize step.

MB-001 verification complete on host Mech after an independent review written before the Migration Report. Two in-boundary repairs on the same branch: the consumption test no longer derives its expectation from the acceptsWork under test (fixed expectations over the gateway's own responses, proven discriminating by a mutation check), and a new restart/recovery receipt proves interrupted work is never falsified as success. Donor parity was rebuilt from a clone of Codex-Boss at 8df428e: 11/11 closed-set and bound checks, and the CODEOWNERS grammar is the same canonical token stream with 50000/50000 patterns and 350000/350000 path verdicts agreeing. Gates green at 8349b61: root 61/61, city 229/229, rooms 67/67, promotion-history 10 records, check:docs SYNCHRONIZED, Android lane built from scratch 21/21 unit tests, hosted CI 36583350117 and 36584692434 both success. Client-side Web or Android execution against a live gateway was not performed here; recorded as a boundary, not manufactured.
